sources.title: SpamShield | Azhar Ahmed
sources.snippet: Spam evolves. Detection must too. Email spam is more than an annoyance—it's a gateway for phishing, fraud, and security breaches. Traditional rule-based filters fall short against evolving language patterns. SpamShield brings Transformer-based NLP to email security, fine-tuning DistilBERT on 190,000+ emails for deep contextual understanding.

sources.snippet: 🛡️ SpamShield — AI-Powered Mail Detector This is a production-ready version of the SpamShield detector, optimized for Hugging Face Spaces. It uses a fine-tuned BERT architecture to classify emails as SPAM or SAFE in real-time.
